name: min_wal_size
description: Sets the minimum size to which the WAL directory is shrunk during checkpoint cleanup; defines the lower bound for WAL file recycling.
symptoms: Write stalls during high WAL generation
Poor write throughput under burst loads
tuning_tips: Increase min_wal_size to absorb write bursts (e.g., batch jobs) and reduce checkpoint pressure; set it between 1x–4x typical WAL generation rate per checkpoint interval.
